name: External Agent Instruction 1 Code
definition: Specifies further instructions for the agent concerning the processing of an instruction.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

CHQB.name: Pay Creditor By Cheque
CHQB.definition: (Ultimate) creditor must be paid by cheque.

HOLD.name: Hold Cash For Creditor
HOLD.definition: Amount of money must be held for the (ultimate) creditor, who will call. Pay on identification.

INQR.name: Inquiry Reason
INQR.definition: Additional Information to an inquiry reason must be provided.

PBEN.name: Pay The Beneficiary
PBEN.definition: (Ultimate) creditor to be paid only after verification of identity.

PHOA.name: Phone Next Agent
PHOA.definition: Please advise/contact next agent by phone.

TELA.name: Telecom Next Agent
TELA.definition: Please advise/contact next agent by the most efficient means of telecommunication.

TELB.name: Telecom
TELB.definition: Please advise/contact (ultimate) creditor/claimant by the most efficient means of telecommunication.

TFRO.name: Time From
TFRO.definition: Payment instruction will be valid and eligible for execution from the date and time stipulated.

TTIL.name: Time Till
TTIL.definition: Payment instruction is valid and eligible for execution until the date and time stipulated. Otherwise, the payment instruction will be rejected.
